findings: The ATM stores an immutable KAIOS address but never requires either quote leg to equal KAIOS, so the alleged bilateral KAIOS boundary is not enforced and arbitrary token-token or token-BNB pairs are accepted.

The ATM low-level transfer helpers accept an empty successful return without checking token.code.length. An EOA or non-contract token address therefore appears to transfer successfully, allowing an attacker to accept an escrowed real asset without delivering the requested ERC20 leg, or to create a quote with a nonexistent maker asset and obtain the taker's real asset.

ATM, vault, and clearing credit nominal transfer amounts without verifying balance deltas. Fee-on-transfer, rebasing, or otherwise non-exact tokens can underfund escrow or reserves while accounting records the full requested value.
The margin vault does not verify that its immutable KAIOS address contains code and can credit deposits even when low-level calls to a non-contract address return success with empty data.

Warp clearing gives one immutable administrator immediate oracle and risk-cap control and a single mutable oracle sole mark authority, without timelock, quorum, conflict-of-interest separation, signed provenance, or independent receipt evidence.

An administrator/oracle coalition can open a position, choose a favorable mark, and repeatedly extract the liquidity reserve; the contract provides no commit-reveal, counterparty evidence, or governance boundary.

Reserve funding has no provider shares or withdrawal path, while only the player can close a position. Abandoned or losing positions, or a stale/stopped oracle, can lock reserve and margin indefinitely because there is no liquidation, expiry, emergency close, or recovery path.
Mark prices are not numerically bounded; uint-to-int conversion and delta-times-warp arithmetic can overflow or revert, making a position uncloseable.

The local warp model accepts caller-created VERIFIED_SETTLED KAIOS receipt objects and caller-set reference marks without authoritative provider, freshness, quorum, receipt inclusion, or replay evidence.
The local model labels itself fully collateralized but does not maintain a counterparty reserve; winning PnL is created by JavaScript arithmetic and withdrawable from the review ledger.
Quote, price, balance, and PnL arithmetic uses JavaScript Number, exposing precision, rounding, overflow-to-infinity, and non-finite-value risks for token-denominated state.

PRODUCT_CONTRACTS being null is a positive fail-closed default, but merely filling addresses unlocks approvals, deposits, trades, closes, and withdrawals without enforcing deployment receipt hash, code hash, proxy implementation, chain evidence, revocation, or Human release authorization.
The live wallet bridge contains protected Mainnet signing paths and static addresses; the UI also loads a third-party WalletConnect script from a CDN without subresource integrity.
The quote router imports live-wallet controls as a side effect, coupling model/data import to wallet UI mounting and increasing accidental wallet-surface activation risk.
The branch workflow grants actions:write and contents:write, pushes directly to main, and dispatches Pages. It is forbidden for automatic merge or transplantation.
The exact-head warp page is a stale V4.0 side surface with no current V4.1 Chromium, responsive, accessibility, or screenshot evidence.
PR comments are implementation checkpoints and a historical direct-main claim, not independent review, Human authorization, deployment proof, or production authority.
Ancestors #169 and #195 are closed unmerged, parent #200 remains held, and current main contains newer safer successors; this stacked branch cannot inherit current authority.
positive_controls: ATM and clearing deployment addresses remain null, so the candidate browser path is currently fail-closed.
No private key or signer secret is present in the audited diff.
The ATM candidate does not mint KAIOS or call the White-Hole conversion mechanism.
Historical lifecycle tests deploy local mock contracts on Ganache and do not prove Testnet or Mainnet deployment.
The candidate does not treat the KGEN/KAIOS physics scale as a fixed market exchange rate.
Contract entry points use nonReentrant guards and generally follow checks-effects-interactions.

limitations: Historical branch-only evidence; it is not current-main integration evidence.
Tests use caller-created receipt and oracle data plus local mock tokens and Ganache, so they do not prove production identity, custody, solvency, or settlement.
Checkout and setup-node v4 are historical and emit Node.js 20 deprecation warnings.
No exact-head Game Product QA, Responsive QA, Chromium, screenshot, or visual artifact exists.

work_order_assertions: exactly 12 unique PR-relative paths are classified
all audited path SHA fields are null or 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters

safe_successor_requirements: Restrict ATM pairs to explicitly authorized assets, require code-bearing token contracts, and reject nonstandard exact-leg behavior using measured balance deltas or an audited allowlist.
Bind vault and clearing KAIOS identity to an exact deployment manifest and verify actual balance changes before crediting custody or reserve accounting.
Separate oracle, administrator, trader, and reserve-provider authority with durable governance, timelock, signed provenance, freshness, conflict controls, and emergency recovery.
Add bounded arithmetic, liquidation, expiry, emergency close, stale-oracle recovery, reserve-provider accounting, and withdrawal semantics before any real-value rehearsal.
Replace caller-created receipts and JavaScript Number accounting with authoritative replay-safe receipts and exact bounded decimal or integer units.
Keep wallet, approval, deployment, and signing functions fail-closed behind Human release authorization, exact code hashes, receipt hashes, proxy identity, chain binding, and revocation.
Do not transplant the write-token workflow; use current read-only exact-head validation only.
Integrate only into exact current V4.1 shell and complete Chromium plus 390x844 screenshot QA before any UI successor is considered.
